description.value: You are immune to the slowed condition from your own Someday feats and Rites. Once per day, you may ignore a single instance of the slowed or stunned condition entirely, as though it had never applied. The Someday postpones plenty. It never postpones you.

cinderfall.incomplete: Both clauses fail despite looking REAL-shaped at first glance. "Immune to the slowed condition from your OWN Someday feats and Rites" is scoped narrower than blanket immunity (unlike absolute-certainty/beyond-doubt's stated blanket immunities) -- an unscoped Immunity would over-grant immunity to slowed from every source, a 'convert, never flatten' violation, and no predicate token exists for "this condition's origin is one of my own items." "Once per day, ignore a single instance of slowed or stunned entirely, as though it never applied" is P-DEGREE-REACTIVE: applied after the condition is already in effect, at player discretion, once per day -- the same after-the-fact-manufacture shape as beyond-doubt, not the unconditional-passive shape there-is-no-doubt uses.
